profile.heroHeadline: Making complex data useful, dependable, and secure.
profile.heroIntro: I build and improve data platforms, operational information systems, and decision-support tools that help teams turn fragmented information into practical action.
profile.philosophy: My focus is not simply collecting data. It is making information consistent, secure, and useful to the people who depend on it.
bio: Moses Alabi is a data, database, and information systems professional with more than 11 years of experience across information management, application development, digital data workflows, analytics, and programme operations with the International Organization for Migration (IOM) in Nigeria.

His professional experience includes relational database development, SQL Server administration, data integration, data quality assurance, government-facing screening applications, dashboards, geospatial reporting, digital data-collection workflows, and operational decision support.
He holds an MSc in Computing and Information Systems with Distinction from Liverpool John Moores University, United Kingdom.

His academic research examined cybersecurity in cloud computing, including security threats, mitigation strategies, governance frameworks, and emerging approaches. This experience supports his interest in secure, reliable, well-governed, and human-centred information systems.

His broader interests include data engineering, trustworthy digital infrastructure, responsible AI, decision-support systems, and technology that helps public-sector and humanitarian organisations make better decisions.

projects.title: Integrated Case Data and SQL Workflows
projects.summary: Developing SQL integration processes and data-validation routines to consolidate operational records into a structured case-management data environment.
projects.problem: Operational records arriving from multiple sources in different structures make reporting slow and inconsistent, and make it hard to trust a single view of a case.
projects.role: Designed and developed SQL Server integration processes, database objects, and validation routines as part of the information-management team.
projects.approach: Source records are mapped to a consistent relational model, passed through validation and de-duplication routines in T-SQL, and loaded into a structured case-management environment that reporting can query directly.
projects.relevance: A consolidated, validated dataset gives programme teams a more dependable basis for case follow-up and reporting.
projects.confidentiality: Summary of professional experience. Source data, schemas, and system details are confidential and not shown.

projects.title: Government Screening Information System
projects.summary: Developing and supporting screening applications for federal- and state-level government operations to standardise information collection and categorisation workflows.
projects.problem: Screening operations need a consistent, structured way to capture and categorise information across different locations and levels of government.
projects.role: Developed and supported screening applications and their database components, and supported users in operational settings.
projects.approach: Requirements were translated into structured digital forms and workflow steps, backed by a relational database with controlled access, so that information is captured the same way wherever screening takes place.
projects.relevance: Structured digital processing reduces variation in how information is recorded and makes categorisation workflows easier to follow and review.
projects.confidentiality: Summary of professional experience. Implementation details, records, and screenshots are confidential and excluded.

projects.title: Operational Analytics and Decision Support
projects.summary: Producing dashboards, statistical outputs, reports, and workflow automations to support programme planning, monitoring, analysis, and evidence-based decisions.
projects.problem: Programme teams need timely, accessible information to plan, monitor progress, and report to stakeholders.
projects.role: Produced analytical reports, statistical outputs, dashboards, and automations drawing on integrated operational data.
projects.approach: Data from integrated SQL sources is shaped into reporting structures, analysed with SQL and Python, and presented through Power BI dashboards, with Power Platform automations handling routine steps.
projects.relevance: Integrated analytics makes operational information easier to find and use for planning, monitoring, and decision-making.
projects.confidentiality: Summary of professional experience. Dashboards and datasets are internal and not shown.

projects.title: Field Data Collection and Geospatial Insight
projects.summary: Supporting digital surveys, field data quality assurance, community mapping, and geospatial outputs for operational assessments and monitoring.
projects.problem: Field assessments depend on well-structured collection tools and geographic data that is accurate enough to act on.
projects.role: Designed digital survey tools, trained field staff, coordinated surveys, and performed GIS data quality assurance.
projects.approach: Structured KoboToolbox forms capture consistent field data; quality-assurance checks catch errors early; ArcGIS and QGIS turn validated data into maps for assessments and monitoring.
projects.relevance: Linking structured collection, quality assurance, and geospatial analysis gives operational teams a clearer picture on the ground.
projects.confidentiality: Summary of professional experience. Location data and beneficiary information are confidential and excluded.
